Removes an unnecessary type assertion in PDF table-of-contents handling and enables the matching local lint rule so it is checked before release. Reading behavior is unchanged.

The review's vault-enumeration and clipboard recommendations describe capabilities used by the plugin. Reading Desk lists PDFs for the document picker and Markdown paths for template suggestions; legacy export cleanup also checks Markdown notes for links. The Copy action writes passage text to the clipboard and does not read its contents. These operations are documented in the README.

Requires Obsidian desktop 1.14.4 or newer. Runtime verification covers Linux.
